name: Karan Kapur
tagline: Engineer. Co-founder of thaw. Based in Madison, WI. Open to relocating in the US.
intro: I started coding to settle an argument with my dad about IPL. My first project was a match predictor.
I co-founded thaw, where I own the storage layer that lets a running LLM session fork in under a second. I also built RelayIQ, which decides whether a lead is worth enriching before you pay for it.
Before any of that I played table tennis at the national level in India. These days I cook, DJ, golf, and follow F1 closely.
I'm looking for a founding engineer, forward deployed or GTM engineering role at an AI startup.
education: B.S. Computer Science and Data Science, Certificate in Entrepreneurship, University of Wisconsin-Madison, May 2026.
